author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing had a flat, squashed arch over two lumpy bars and read as a telephone handset on a rack. Redrawn after the reference: a true semicircular stone arch (outer r14, inner r6) with flat feet, over two smooth in-phase wave rows. The troughs sit under the feet and a crest sits under the opening.
omissions: The arch spans less than the full width so both wave rows fit 8 or more below it.
